verdict.rationale: Codex supports running multiple parallel cloud tasks, browsing active/completed chats, and reopening recent sessions from a unified CLI/web interface, which enables managing multiple agent sessions (codex-docs-3, codex-docs-11, codex-docs-15). However, evidence shows real-world friction with quotas/rate limits forcing users to juggle across tools, platform restrictions (Mac-only complaints), and no clear evidence of a true single-pane-of-glass session manager for many concurrent sessions at scale.
